title: AI Ethics and Social Norms: Exploring ChatGPT’s Capabilities From What to How

bias_targets.methodology: A mixed-methods approach using a Likert-scale user survey and semi-structured expert interviews to evaluate perceptions of U.S.-centric training data and how AI outputs vary in quality and relevance across different global and local cultural contexts (e.g., Iran vs. Western countries).
Quantitative Likert-scale survey questions asking users to rate their perception of ChatGPT's bias when handling sensitive political questions and its potential bias against conservative viewpoints.

Qualitative semi-structured interviews with AI experts discussing user observations on whether the model exhibits gender bias and how it handles sensitive topics related to LGBTQ+ identity and mental health.
Qualitative semi-structured interviews assessing expert perceptions of how the model's training data reflects and potentially amplifies broader societal racial biases.
